summary: Frontend testing completed for Dagon SQL learning platform. All critical features tested and working: drag-and-drop bug fix CONFIRMED working, login/register flows, navigation, and XP reward animation.

drag_and_drop.details: Successfully dragged SELECT, *, FROM, usuarios to drop zone. Query 'SELECT * FROM usuarios' validated correctly.

validation_and_xp_reward.details: Validation API returned success, +10 XP reward animation displayed with '¡Perfecto!' message and 3 stars.

login.details: Login with dragon123@test.com / Dragon123! works correctly, redirects to dashboard.

register.details: New user registration works, creates account and redirects to dashboard with tutorial overlay.

navigation_dashboard_to_exercise.details: Clicking on 'Nivel 0 - Desde Cero' navigates to exercise page with theory content.

navigation_exercise_to_dashboard.details: Back button (Volver) returns to dashboard correctly.

theory_page.details: 'Comenzar Práctica' button transitions from theory to drag-drop exercise.

critical_code_review_comments: Drag-and-drop fix is solid - using numeric IDs (word-0, word-1) instead of word text avoids special character issues
Word objects {id, word} pattern is clean and maintainable
context_for_next_testing_agent: All drag-and-drop functionality working. Test user dragon123@test.com has 30 XP after completing nivel-0 exercise. MOCK_EXERCISES and MOCK_LEVELS are used for exercise data (not from database).
mocked_apis_note: GET /api/exercises/{level_id} and GET /api/levels return MOCK data defined in server.py. Auth APIs (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/register) and validation API (/api/exercises/validate) work with real MongoDB.
